identityAssessment.finding: The Acaxea polygons lie in the Durango-Sinaloa highlands, approximately 108.04 to 106.00 degrees west and 24.22 to 26.26 degrees north. The name is clarified to Acaxee communities, consistent with the scholarly regional identification. The separate Pacaxes label is not merged, because a broad Acaxee affiliation does not establish interchangeable map identities. No geometry is certified.

scopeNotes: Cueva del Maguey supplies explicitly labelled regional context, not a claimed excavation of an Acaxee capital.
Pérez de Ribas is a colonial missionary source; hostile supernatural and ethnic judgments are not repeated as factual descriptions.
The sources use different chronological descriptions of cultural dissolution; no exact extinction year is asserted.
